body.heading: Where in the world is Dominican Republic?
paragraphs: Dominican Republic is a country in Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Dominican Republic is Santo Domingo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Dominican Republic is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Dominican Republic is the Dominican peso.

body.heading: How big is Dominican Republic?
paragraphs: Dominican Republic covers about 49,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Belize.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Punta Cana's palm-fringed white beaches and calm turquoise water are the Caribbean's classic family resort coast.
Santo Domingo's Zona Colonial is the oldest European city centre in the Americas — the first cathedral, castle and hospital of the New World.
